claim_text: The National Assn. of Black Journalists presented ESPN 'First Take' host Stephen A. Smith with its annual 'Thumbs Down' award at its convention on Saturday, citing a recurring public pattern of disparaging commentary directed at prominent Black women across politics, sports and media.
quote: Stephen A. Smith received the equivalent of a failing grade Saturday from the National Assn. of Black Journalists, which blasted his consistent takedowns of Black female politicians.
confidence_justification: An award announced at a public convention with the organisation's statement quoted in the report.
